question_text: Discuss replacing independent junction controllers with one networked central traffic controller.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: A central system can coordinate signals to reduce queues across several junctions and simplify updates. However, the central computer or its communication links become critical failure points; loss of communication may disrupt many junctions. Local fallback control can reduce the risk while retaining coordination benefits.
